meta.author: The Beard
meta.name: Arkham Irregulars
meta.description: Ten fan-made investigators and their signature cards.

cards.name: Rodrigo Álvarez
cards.text:
[reaction] After you successfully attack an enemy with a basic fight action: Play an event, paying its cost. If you succeeded by 2 or more, reduce the cost of that event by 1. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign]: +1. If you succeed, you may immediately take a basic fight action against an enemy at your location.
cards.back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Guardian cards ([guardian]) level 0–5, Neutral cards 0–5, up to 6 other Rogue and/or Survivor events and/or skills ([rogue] and/or [survivor]) level 0–2. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Lucha Libre, El Chupacabra, 1 random basic weakness.
cards.back_flavor: Rodrigo grew up as many young men did in the Jalisco region of Mexico: working on the family farms and engaging in sports whenever time allowed. The growing phenomenon of lucha libre with its pageantry and larger-than-life personas swayed Rodrigo into the life of a professional wrestler, where he assumed the persona of Fantasma Rojo. However, when news of bizarre livestock mutilation in his hometown reached him, Rodrigo immediately took action. What he found defied reason, and hinted at greater evils at work, but Fantasma Rojo never turned down a challenge.

cards.name: Lucha Libre
cards.text: Rodrigo Álvarez deck only. Fight ([combat]). You get +1 [combat] for this attack. This attack deals +1 damage and ignores the retaliate and elusive keywords. If this attack defeats an enemy, you may shuffle Lucha Libre back into your deck.

cards.name: El Chupacabra
cards.text: Hunter. Prey – Rodrigo Álvarez only. Forced – When you would deal 2 or more damage to El Chupacabra: If El Chupacabra is ready, it makes an immediate attack against you. Otherwise, it readies.

cards.name: Cora Montague
cards.text:
[reaction] After you attach a player card to an investigator, asset, or encounter card at your location: Immediately activate an ability on the attached card (without paying its [action] cost) or heal 1 horror. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign]: +1. Gain 1 resource for each card you control with 1 or more cards attached to it.
cards.flavor:
"Proper measure must be taken to
keep these artifacts from misuse."
cards.back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Guardian cards ([guardian]) level 0–5, Neutral cards level 0–5, cards that attach any cards to investigators, assets, or encounter cards level 0–2, up to 5 other [[Relic]] cards level 0. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Helical Fragment, Leaking Malevolence, 1 random basic weakness
cards.back_flavor: The Montague family was never a particularly wealthy one, but they were nevertheless well regarded in Arkham's social circles. It was no coincidence that Cora's mother was a member of the Silver Twilight Lodge, acting as one of many keepers for the lodge's more volatile artifacts. Cora was raised to follow in her mother's footsteps, learning the duties and doctrine of the role, but before her training could be completed, Cora's mother vanished without a trace, leaving only a cryptic written warning about the lodge's collection. Thrust into the role of keeper now, Cora must determine what dark secrets lie dormant in the relics while doing her duty to keep them safely under lock and key.

deck_options.name: Cards that attach cards to investigators, assets, or encounter cards

cards.name: Helical Fragment
cards.text:
Cora Montague deck only.
[reaction] When you initiate an attack on an asset you control, exhaust a card you control attached to that asset: Treat each [skull], [cultist], [tablet], and [elder_thing] token revealed during this attack as '0' instead.
[reaction] When you initiate an attack against an enemy with 1 or more cards you control attached to it, exhaust Helical Fragment: This attack deals +1 damage.

cards.name: Leaking Malevolence
cards.text: Revelation – Put Leaking Malevolence into play in your threat area. Forced – At the end of your turn, discard a card you control that is attached to another card. If you cannot, take 1 horror instead. [action] [action]: Discard Leaking Malevolence.

cards.name: Virginia Perkins
cards.text:
[reaction] After you discover 1 or more clues via an event or ability printed on an asset you control: Choose a set-aside copy of Cataloguing and shuffle it into your deck. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign]: +1. Reveal the top card of any player's deck. Its owner may draw that card. Otherwise, shuffle that card back into its owner's deck.
cards.flavor:
"We can't forget, no matter
how painful it may be."
cards.back_text: Deck Size: 35. Deckbuilding Options: Seeker cards ([seeker]) level 0–5, Neutral cards level 0–5, cards that "shuffle cards into," "look at," or "search" a deck level 0–2. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): 4 copies of Cataloguing, Better Left Forgotten, 1 random basic weakness. Additional Setup: You begin the game with each copy of Cataloguing set aside, out of play.
cards.back_flavor: Anything could be important to history. Virginia had seen it plenty of times where seemingly mundane events were just the start of something much larger. While others might have simply scratched their heads, Virginia's curiosity always led her to listen, research, and remember. The young woman joined the ranks of Arkham's Historical Society as soon as she was able, and steeped herself in pieces of the past that she could analyze... until the collection began to fade. Missing articles, dead end references, and dozens of books that weren't taken, but simply didn't exist anymore. There had to be an explanation, and Virginia would be the one to find it.

deck_options.name: Cards that "shuffle cards into," "look at," or "search" a deck

cards.name: Cataloguing (Cross-Reference)
cards.text: Virginia Perkins deck only. [reaction] After you draw Cataloguing (Cross-Reference): Reveal it and look at the top 4 cards of any player deck or the encounter deck. Return the looked at cards to the top of that deck in any order. Forced – When Cataloguing (Cross-Reference) would enter your discard pile: Set it aside, out of play instead.

cards.name: Cataloguing (Detailed Record)
cards.text: Virginia Perkins deck only. [reaction] After you draw Cataloguing (Detailed Record): Reveal it and choose an investigator. The chosen investigator may choose up to 3 cards in their discard pile and shuffle them into their deck. Forced – When Cataloguing (Detailed Record) would enter your discard pile: Set it aside, out of play instead.

cards.name: Cataloguing (Penciled Margins)
cards.text: Virginia Perkins deck only. [reaction] After you draw Cataloguing (Penciled Margins): Reveal it and draw 2 cards. Forced – When Cataloguing (Penciled Margins) would enter your discard pile: Set it aside, out of play instead.

cards.name: Cataloguing (Unfinished Section)
cards.text: Virginia Perkins deck only. [reaction] After you draw Cataloguing (Unfinished Section): Reveal it and take an immediate investigate action as if it were your turn. Forced – When Cataloguing (Unfinished Section) would enter your discard pile: Set it aside, out of play instead.

cards.name: Better Left Forgotten
cards.text: Revelation – Discard the top 5 cards of your deck and draw each weakness discarded. If there are 10 or more cards remaining in your deck, take 1 horror and shuffle this card back into your deck. Forced – If you search or look at cards in your deck and this card is among the searched or looked at cards: Draw it.

cards.name: Leroy Stanton
cards.text:
[reaction] After you discard a card via a player effect: Reduce your location's shroud by 1 for the next action initiated this round.
[free] During your turn, discard a card from your hand: Draw a card. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign]: +2. You may discard a card committed to this test.
cards.flavor:
"With the whole world at stake,
you can bet efficiency counts."
cards.back_text: Deck Size: 40. Deckbuilding Options: Seeker cards ([seeker]) level 0–5, Neutral cards level 0–5, cards that discard other cards level 0–2, up to 5 other Rogue and/or Survivor cards ([rogue] and/or [survivor]) level 0. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Working Overtime, Overworked, 1 random basic weakness.
cards.back_flavor: Arkham's Northside district runs on the sweat and dedication of its factory workers, and few are more focused on the job than Leroy Stanton. From line worker to shift manager to floor foreman, Leroy earned everything he got, and was always focused on the next steps. He had a mind for efficiency, and even the factory owners took his suggestions when their egos allowed. However, his orderly mind was finally met with a challenge he couldn't easily reason out when night shift workers began to disappear without a trace. Leroy readied himself for a new line of work.

deck_options.name: Cards that discard other cards

cards.name: Working Overtime
cards.text:
Leroy Stanton deck only. Working Overtime does not ready during the upkeep phase.
[free] During the investigation phase, except during an action, exhaust Working Overtime: Take an immediate action as if it were your turn.
[reaction] After you discard 2 or more total cards from your hand during the same turn: Ready Working Overtime. (Limit once per round.)

cards.name: Overworked
cards.text: Revelation – Put Overworked into play in your threat area. Forced – After one of your card effects discards 1 or more cards: Lose 1 action. Forced – When the upkeep phase begins, if you did not discard any cards via player effects this round: Discard Overworked.

cards.name: Perry Baxter
cards.text:
[reaction] When you would discover 1 or more clues from a location without your investigator mini-card: Discover 1 additional clue from that location. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign]: +1. You may immediately move to a connecting location before resolving this test.
cards.flavor: "The public has a right to know, even if I have to break the rules."
cards.back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Rogue cards ([rogue]) level 0–5, Neutral cards level 0–5, cards with "connecting location," "revealed location," or "any location" level 0–2. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Information Network, Blackout Agent, 1 random basic weakness.
cards.back_flavor: When radio came to Arkham, it was a mere novelty. The broadcasts from Boston and New York gave all the news that most people cared to hear, but Perry was not most people. As a frequent columnist for the Arkham Advertiser, he was no stranger to the bizarre happenings of the town, and he knew that Doyle Jeffries and others like him had no intention of letting the public know the half of it. When Arkham finally funded its own radio station, Perry lobbied to be its first host, fully intending to bring the hidden matters of Arkham to light. However, on the first night, Perry was confronted by a group of strange men with a single clear message: Stick to the script... and they'll be listening to every word.

cards.name: Information Network
cards.text:
Perry Baxter deck only.
While there are no clues on the location with your investigator mini-card, you get +1 [intellect].
[reaction] After you discover a clue from a location, exhaust Information Network: Move once toward that location.

cards.name: Blackout Agent
cards.text: Spawn – Any location (without investigators, if possible). Forced – After an investigator discovers 1 or more clues from a location without their investigator mini-card, if Blackout Agent is unengaged: Blackout Agent readies and moves one location at a time toward that investigator, then engages that investigator.

cards.name: Camila Palacios
cards.text:
[reaction] After you play an event with "[[Firearm]]" or an event that targets a [[Firearm]] asset you control: Search the top 3 cards of your deck for an event and draw it. Shuffle your deck. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign]: +1. You may choose an event in your discard pile and shuffle it into your deck.
cards.flavor:
"Anything worth doing
is worth doing in style."
cards.back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Rogue cards ([rogue]) level 0–5, Neutral cards level 0–5, up to 10 other [[Firearm]], [[Tactic]], and/or [[Upgrade]] cards level 0–2. Additional Requirements: 2 copies of Hair Trigger, Edward Griffith, 1 random basic weakness.
cards.back_flavor: The Palacios family was one of the many success stories of Arkham's French Hill neighborhood. Camila's father was in constant competition with his affluent neighbors, most directly the Griffith family. Camila was educated and trained to outdo the Griffiths' son in several fields, though Camila loved working with firearms the most, becoming an accomplished trick shooter in the process. When at last the Griffith family went bankrupt, the Palacios simply moved on. But some months later, inexplicable tragedies began to befall the family, including Camila's father sudden descent into inexplicable madness. There had to be some dark underlying reason, and Camila was ready to apply her talents to find out.

cards.name: Hair Trigger
cards.text:
Camilia Palacios deck only.
Ready each [[Firearm]] asset you control. One at a time, take a fight action printed on each [[Firearm]] asset you control. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

cards.name: Edward Griffith
cards.text: Hunter. Prey – Camila Palacios only. Forced – When you search or look at cards in your deck, and Edward Griffith is among the searched or looked at cards: You must either draw Edward Griffith or he attacks you (from your deck).
cards.flavor:
"I bet you forgot about me.
You Palacios always were full of yourselves."

cards.name: Mildred Nash
cards.text:
[reaction] After you reveal an [elder_sign], [skull], [cultist], [tablet], or [elder_thing] token during a skill test: Choose one of your cards committed to that test and either double the icons on that card or resolve its printed effect an additional time. (Limit once per test.)
[elder_sign]: 0. You may choose both options instead while resolving the above [reaction] ability.
cards.back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Mystic cards ([mystic]) level 0–5, Neutral cards level 0-5, up to 10 other skills level 0–2. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Magic of Cinema, Film Editing, Perilous Scenes, 1 random basic weakness.
cards.back_flavor: Mildred was a practical woman, but there was one thing above all others that captured her sense of wonder: the silver screen. There was certainly a kind of magic in the way that the films played, an otherworldly quality in the recorded motions in the flicker of the projector's light. Mildred found employment in the projection room of the Riverview Theater, operating the camera and gradually learning each silent movie by heart... except for one. The unmarked roll of film that appeared in the booth one day played out with much more realism, much more horrid imagery, and most shockingly, starring Mildred in events that had never happened – yet.

cards.name: Magic of Cinema
cards.text:
Permanent. Mildred Nash deck only.
[reaction] After you commit 2 or more cards to an attack you are performing, exhaust Magic of Cinema: This attack deals +1 damage.
[reaction] After you commit 2 or more cards to an investigation you are performing, exhaust Magic of Cinema: If you succeed, discover 1 additional clue.

cards.name: Film Editing
cards.text:
Mildred Nash deck only.
[reaction] After you initiate a skill test: Commit Film Editing to that test from your hand. All icons count as matching for this test. If you succeed, draw 1 card for each unique non-[wild] icon committed to this test.
cards.flavor: "What if the sequence was spliced like this...?"

cards.name: Perilous Scenes
cards.text: Revelation – Put Perilous Scenes into play in your threat area. As an additional cost to commit one or more cards to a skill test you are performing, choose and discard a card from your hand or take 1 damage. [action] [action]: Discard Perilous Scenes.

cards.name: Yosef Chaim Mandelstam
cards.text:
[reaction] When you would draw cards during the upkeep phase: Instead, search the top X cards of your deck for any card and draw it, where X is 1 plus the number of cards you control with chaos tokens sealed on them. If there are 1 or more weaknesses among the searched cards, also draw one of the looked-at weaknesses. Shuffle your deck.
[elder_sign]: +1. You may seal this token on your investigator card. At the end of the round, release it.
cards.back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Mystic cards ([mystic]) level 0–5, Neutral cards level 0–5, cards that seal tokens level 0–3, up to 5 other [[Insight]] and/or [[Research]] cards level 0–2. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Pardes Rimonim, Unraveling Veils, 1 random basic weakness.
cards.back_flavor: In any community, even one without dark fears rampant, its people rely on figures of experience and wisdom to help soothe their troubles. Rebbe Yosef has long acted as a voice of comfort and guidance, operating from the small synagogue in Rivertown. However, as the years went by, the people came to Yosef with tales of horror that mere logic could not overcome. Determined to protect his community, Yosef delved into mystic texts and researched counters to such evils. Now he sets forth, armed with sanctified knowledge.

cards.name: Pardes Rimonim
cards.text: Yosef Chaim Mandelstam deck only. Forced – When your turn begins or Pardes Rimonim enters play: Seal a random non-[auto_fail] chaos token on Pardes Rimonim. At the end of the round, release this token. [reaction] When you search your deck, exhaust Pardes Rimonim: Draw 1 additional card among the looked at cards. If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [curse] token is sealed on Pardes Rimonim, take 1 horror.

cards.name: Unravelling Veils
cards.text: Revelation – If there are no chaos tokens sealed among cards you control, shuffle Unraveling Veils back into your deck. Otherwise, for each card you control with 1 or more chaos tokens sealed on it, you must either (choose one): [bullet] Release each chaos token sealed on that card. [bullet] Take 1 damage.
cards.flavor:
"The Sitra Achra is barren and does not bear fruit."
– The Zohar

cards.name: Rosamund Fenner
cards.text: You may take an additional action during your turn, which can only be used to activate an [action] ability on an asset you control that does not have a bold action designator. (Fight, investigate, evade, etc.) [elder_sign]: +1. If you succeed, you may play an asset with an [action] ability printed on it (paying its cost). If you succeed by 2 or more, reduce the printed cost of that asset by 1.
cards.back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Survivor cards ([survivor]) level 0–5, Neutral cards level 0–5, [[Tool]] and [[Upgrade]] cards level 0, other assets with printed [action] abilities without bold action designators level 0–2. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Refurbishing, Gone to Pieces, 1 random basic weakness.
cards.back_flavor: Rosamund never had a place to call home. She barely remembered her parents, and her aunt brought Rosamund with her as she roamed from town to town, mending kettles, straightening wheels, and performing other odd jobs. Rosamund took to the life easily, satisfied in working with her hands. While passing through Kingsport, Rosamund's aunt left her to perform a simple job. It would be the last that she heard of her aunt until two days later, when the police discovered her body at the base of the cliffs, face frozen in terror. Mystery or not, the death of a transient was of little consequence to the locals. If there was to be any justice—or answers—it would be by Rosamund's own hand.

deck_options.name: Assets with printed action abilities without bold action designators

cards.name: Refurbishing
cards.text:
Rosamund Fenner deck only.
[reaction] After you activate an [action] ability without a bold action designator, exhaust Refurbishing: Draw a card or gain a resource.
[action]: Add 1 supply or ammo to an asset controlled by an investigator at your location.

cards.name: Gone to Pieces
cards.text: Revelation – Discard the non-weakness asset you control with the most non-damage non-horror tokens on it. If no asset was discarded by this effect, shuffle Gone to Pieces back into your deck.

cards.name: Bruce Martin
cards.text:
[reaction] After a card attaches to your location: Take an immediate action as if it were your turn. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign]: +1. You may choose a card attached to your location and attach it to a connecting revealed location, or vice versa.
cards.flavor:
"Something's out there, and
it ain't just wild animals."
cards.back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Survivor cards ([survivor]) level 0–5, Neutral cards level 0–5, cards that attach to locations level 0–3. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Lay of the Land, Advancing Wilderness, 1 random basic weakness.
cards.back_flavor: While Arkham's woods are strange and steeped in local legends, the government of Massachusetts still portioned out a section of them as an official state park. Unsurprisingly, Arkham locals weren't keen on taking the job of maintaining the park, and so Bruce Martin—a veteran ranger—was appointed to the task. At first he regarded the tales of witches and unnatural sightings as mere superstition, but the longer that Bruce stayed, however, the more he ran into things that couldn't be explained. The forest itself seemed to be alive with malevolent energy, shifting with less subtlety each day with one clear message—humans were not welcome.

cards.name: Lay of the Land
cards.text:
Bruce Martin deck only.
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Attach Lay of the Land to your location.
[free] During a skill test at the attached location, return this card to Bruce Martin's hand: You get +2 skill value for this skill test. Any investigator at the attached location may trigger this ability.

cards.name: Advancing Wilderness
cards.text: Aloof. Patrol (Nearest location with 1 or more player cards attached). Treat the printed text box of each player card attached to Advancing Wilderness's location as if it were blank (except for [[Traits]]). Forced – At the end of the round: Discard each player card attached to Advancing Wilderness's location.
